q.en: In the worked opinion essay, which sentence is the thesis?
q.bn: Worked opinion essay-তে কোন sentence-টা thesis?

options.en: "Many argue that government funds would be better spent..."
options.bn: "Many argue that government funds would be better spent..."

options.en: "I completely agree with this view, mainly because public transport reduces congestion more effectively..."
options.bn: "I completely agree with this view, mainly because public transport reduces congestion more effectively..."

options.en: "For instance, cities that have expanded their metro networks..."
options.bn: "For instance, cities that have expanded their metro networks..."

options.en: "In conclusion, I firmly believe..."
options.bn: "In conclusion, I firmly believe..."

why.en: This sentence states a clear position and the two reasons that the body paragraphs will develop — exactly what a thesis does.
why.bn: এই sentence একটা clear position বলে এবং দুটো reason উল্লেখ করে যা body paragraph develop করবে — thesis যা করে ঠিক সেটাই।

q.en: In the discussion essay, where does the writer's own opinion appear?
q.bn: Discussion essay-তে writer-এর নিজের opinion কোথায় আসে?

options.en: In the introduction, before any views are presented
options.bn: Introduction-এ, কোনো view presented হওয়ার আগে

options.en: In the conclusion, after both views are presented fairly
options.bn: Conclusion-এ, দুটো view fairly presented হওয়ার পরে

options.en: It never appears in a discussion essay
options.bn: Discussion essay-তে এটা কখনো আসে না

options.en: In body paragraph 1 only
options.bn: শুধু body paragraph ১-এ

why.en: A discussion essay presents both views fairly first, and only states the writer's opinion at the end, in the conclusion.
why.bn: Discussion essay প্রথমে দুটো view fairly presents করে, writer-এর opinion শুধু শেষে, conclusion-এ আসে।

q.en: Which four-step pattern does each body paragraph in the opinion essay follow?
q.bn: Opinion essay-র প্রতিটা body paragraph কোন চার-step pattern follow করে?

options.en: Question, answer, example, summary
options.bn: Question, answer, example, summary

options.en: Topic sentence → because → as a result → example
options.bn: Topic sentence → because → as a result → example

options.en: Intro, body, body, conclusion
options.bn: Intro, body, body, conclusion

options.en: Paraphrase, thesis, opinion, conclusion
options.bn: Paraphrase, thesis, opinion, conclusion

why.en: This is the chain-of-reasoning technique from Chapter 9, applied to each body paragraph.
why.bn: এটা Chapter 9-এর chain-of-reasoning technique, প্রতিটা body paragraph-এ applied।

q.en: Why doesn't the discussion essay's introduction state a firm opinion right away?
q.bn: Discussion essay-র introduction কেন সাথে সাথে একটা firm opinion বলে না?

options.en: Because opinions are never allowed in discussion essays
options.bn: কারণ discussion essay-তে opinion কখনো allowed না

options.en: Because a discussion essay must present both views fairly first
options.bn: কারণ discussion essay-তে প্রথমে দুটো view fairly present করতে হয়

options.en: Because the introduction is too short for an opinion
options.bn: কারণ introduction opinion-এর জন্য খুব ছোট

options.en: Because it would use too many words
options.bn: কারণ এতে বেশি শব্দ লাগবে

why.en: Stating an opinion too early would unbalance a discussion essay, which needs to treat both views fairly before concluding.
why.bn: আগে থেকে opinion বলা discussion essay-কে unbalanced করে দেবে, যেখানে conclusion-এর আগে দুটো view-ই fairly treat করতে হয়।

q.en: Which is the correct self-check before submitting a Task 2 essay?
q.bn: Task 2 essay submit করার আগে কোনটা সঠিক self-check?

options.en: Does the conclusion introduce a brand-new argument?
options.bn: Conclusion কি একটা নতুন argument introduce করে?

options.en: Does every body paragraph follow topic sentence → because → as a result → example?
options.bn: প্রতিটা body paragraph কি topic sentence → because → as a result → example follow করে?

options.en: Is the introduction copied word-for-word from the question?
options.bn: Introduction কি question থেকে word-for-word copy করা?

options.en: Is the essay under 150 words?
options.bn: Essay কি ১৫০ শব্দের নিচে?

why.en: Checking that every body paragraph follows the chain-of-reasoning pattern is one of the key self-checks before submitting.
why.bn: প্রতিটা body paragraph chain-of-reasoning pattern follow করছে কিনা check করা submit করার আগে একটা মূল self-check।
